title: A qcqs scheme has a cofinal system of finite affine open coverings with quasi-compact pairwise intersections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then every open covering $X=\bigcup_{a\in A}V_a$ is refined by a finite open covering $X=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$ ($J$ finite, each $U_j$ an affine open contained in some $V_a$) such that $U_j\cap U_{j'}$ is quasi-compact for all $j,j'\in J$. In other words, the finite affine open coverings of $X$ form a cofinal system of open coverings with finite index set and quasi-compact pairwise intersections (hypothesis (3) of Stacks, Modules, Lemma 01BS, and of Sheaves, Lemma 009F (4), for $U=X$).

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01IT (lemma-basis-affine-opens: the affine opens form a basis of the topology), Algebra, Lemma 00E8 (algebra.tex lemma-quasi-compact: Spec R is quasi-compact), Schemes, Lemma 01KO (lemma-characterize-quasi-separated, line 4125: for X quasi-separated the intersection of two affine opens is a finite union of affine opens, hence quasi-compact); the application to hypothesis (3) of Modules 01BS is left implicit by Stacks.

proof.text: *Finite affine refinement.* Let $(V_a)_{a\in A}$ be an open covering of $X$. For every point $x\in X$, choose $a(x)\in A$ with $x\in V_{a(x)}$. Since the affine opens form a basis, choose an affine open $U_x$ with $x\in U_x\subseteq V_{a(x)}$ (Stacks 01IT; in Mathlib this is `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens`, imported from `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/AffineScheme.lean`). The family $(U_x)_{x\in X}$ covers $X$. Quasi-compactness of $X$ gives a finite subset $J\subseteq X$ for which $X=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$ (the finite-subcover operation is Mathlib `IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover`, imported from `Mathlib/Topology/Compactness/Compact.lean`). Thus $(U_j)_{j\in J}$ is a finite affine open covering refining $(V_a)_{a\in A}$, via $j\mapsto a(j)$.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01IT (lemma-basis-affine-opens), together with the definition of quasi-compactness; Algebra, Lemma 00E8 supplies quasi-compactness of affine schemes

proof.text: Each selected affine open U_j is compact by Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.isCompact (Stacks 00E8). Apply Mathlib QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact to the two open compact subsets U_j and U_j' of X, using the assumed QuasiSeparatedSpace X instance, to obtain compactness of their intersection (Stacks 01KO). This directly supplies the last clause without the project lemma pqf-lem-qs-intersection-qc.
